name: Aura
tagline: Platform for Human Evaluation of NLG
description: An open, self-hostable platform for human evaluation of natural language generation, built for under-resourced languages. Runs five evaluation protocols (Likert, pairwise, ranking, error-span, post-editing) with script and speaker provenance, offline capability, and LLM assistant tracking.

name: PANINI Engine
description: Specialized neural machine translation checkpoints for low-resource Indic language pairs (English ↔ Manipuri in both Bengali and Meitei Mayek scripts) trained via rank-stabilized LoRA (rsLoRA) and three-stream self-augmentation.

name: Scriba Toolkit
description: An offline-first desktop and tablet application designed for field linguists and speaker communities. Features synchronized audio elicitation, phonetic time-aligned segmentation, and native writing-system transcription without internet connection.

name: IndicEval Suite
description: A Python evaluation package and benchmark suite measuring automated metric reliability (BLEU, chrF++, COMET) against calibrated human and LLM judges across diverse writing systems and script topologies.

name: Meitei-Align
description: A rule-based and neural transliterator ensuring lossless bi-directional conversion between historical Meitei Mayek glyphs and contemporary Bengali script conventions, correctly resolving complex virama ligatures and tonemarks.

name: Speech Corpus Pipeline
description: End-to-end pipeline for cleaning, noise suppression, and forced alignment of field-recorded indigenous speech archives. Produces manifests ready for Kaldi, Whisper fine-tuning, and Hugging Face Datasets.

name: Bodo-BERT
description: Pre-trained RoBERTa and DeBERTa encoders adapted via continuous masked language modeling for Bodo and related Tibeto-Burman varieties, demonstrating state-of-the-art token classification and POS tagging.

name: LexiField Survey
description: A field survey application built for speaker interviews and Swadesh wordlist recording with offline audio capture, geotagging of speaker dialect zones, and instant cloud backup synchronization.

name: IREN Concordancer
description: A fast web-based KWIC concordance engine and interlinear gloss search environment specifically calibrated for tonal and agglutinative Northeast Indian language corpora.

name: ToneTrack Suite
description: Automated pitch-contour extraction (f0) and tone category error classifier comparing synthetic text-to-speech audio against native speaker pitch tracks.
